poison.name: Poison
poison.description: Duration. Take 15 damage at the start of each tick, then lose 1 duration. Adding Poison extends its duration.

regeneration.name: Regeneration
regeneration.description: Duration. Heal 15 at the start of each tick, then lose 1 duration. Adding Regeneration extends its duration.

ward.name: Ward
ward.description: Shield. Absorbs incoming damage before Health. Does not decay.

interrupt.name: Interrupt
interrupt.description: Cancel an enemy spell that is still casting. That position is skipped; their sequence continues next tick.

empowered.name: Empowered
empowered.description: An enhanced spell. Fire spends 5 Heat on an eligible payoff for its printed Empowered effect. Spells without a printed Empowered damage value gain 50% direct damage, healing and Ward.

tide.name: Tide
tide.description: Charge. Water generates Tide and spends it on printed effects. Tide persists until spent.

heat.name: Heat
heat.description: Charge. Each Heat adds 4% Fire damage. Eligible Empowered Fire payoffs spend 5 Heat. Heat does not decay.

oath.name: Oath
oath.description: A condition on your next 3 spells. Complete all 3 to earn the reward. An interrupt or failed condition breaks it. A new Oath replaces an older one.

slow.name: Slow
slow.description: Charge. The next spell you begin takes one extra tick per Slow, capped at +2T. Consumed on spell start.

cleanse.name: Cleanse
cleanse.description: Remove Poison, Slow, Frailty and Curse from yourself.

repeat.name: Repeat
repeat.description: Resolve a spell’s effects again without advancing the sequence. A repeat does not count as another spell for Oaths or augment counters.

consume.name: Consume
consume.description: Remove the named duration or charges and use the amount removed for the payoff.

channel.name: Channel
channel.description: Gain power for adjacent copies of the same spell in your ordered hand.

unique.name: Unique
unique.description: Only one copy may be held. Matching shop copies can still upgrade it.

cycle.name: Cycle
cycle.description: One pass through your sequence, followed by one reshuffle tick.

frailty.name: Frailty
frailty.description: Duration. Take 20% more incoming enemy damage. Loses 1 duration at the end of each following tick.

curse.name: Curse
curse.description: Duration. Completing the same domain twice in succession costs 25 Health. Loses 1 duration at the end of each following tick.

affinity.name: Affinity
affinity.description: At 3 cards in a domain, its direct damage, healing and Ward gain 10% power. At 5 cards, Mastery increases this to 20%. At most two Masteries fit a 10-card deck.
